szoveg_eredeti:
We are very excited to share that Modal is the main sponsor of the NeurIPS 2026 × ML Intern Repro Hackathon, hosted by Gradio and Hugging Face! 🎉

The question: can AI agents reproduce the main result of a NeurIPS 2026 paper? 
Pick a paper from our list of thousands of paper claims, reproduce it with Hugging Face 's own ML Intern or any agent of your choice, and publish your code, logs, and verdict (claim verified, falsified, or inconclusive).

Now, we know that reproducing papers takes GPUs. This is where Modal partnership brings great value for the hackathon participants: 
⚡ $100 in Modal credits for each of the first 1,000 eligible participants 
🏆 $5,000 in Modal credits for the Best Reproduction on Modal 
🎁 $1,000 in Modal credits each for Best workflow app, Best explainer, Open artifact, and Community choice awards 
📺 Office-hours livestream with a Modal representative 

🤑🤑🤑 Together with Maritime's LLM credits and Hugging Face credits, that's over $10,000 in prizes plus $170 in credits per participant.

📅 Hackathon: Nov 30 – Dec 13 · Registration closes Nov 29 👉 https://lnkd.in/gxNNwmDy 

Thank you Radhika Gulati , Andrew Hinh and the Modal team for backing open, reproducible research 🙏
